coordinateSystem: Native grid XYZ, Z up, blueprint block indices; cell (x,y,z) covers [x,x+1)x[y,y+1)x[z,z+1)
rule: 8x8 rays per face; covering surface = nearest opaque static surface within 0.35 behind (or 0.02 proud of) the face plane; every covering normal within 5.0 deg of the outward axis and 1.0 deg of the covering mean; one plane (depths within 0.05) covers >= 60%; on side faces an eave sloping up from the wall in the top 25% is neither wall nor curve; depths compared to 1e-05 (float32 exports); glass counts as a surface; no animated geometry within 1.0 in front in any pose (rest and every frame, exact overlap)
excluded: Water, WalkwayRail nodes, animated nodes; native props are not in the model; glass counts as a surface
